FROM (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,

    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions` p

    pt.gender = 'M'
    AND pt.anchor_age BETWEEN 66 AND 76
    AND p.drug ILIKE '%digoxin%'
